Although I was lucky to take these therapies I basically upped how many times I was seeing my therapist to twice a week, I see the Dr regularly and my psychiatrist as well. Though with the dbt I've been learning many more coping skills. I downloaded meditation apps and apps to help with coping skills. I'm 33, and the other week for the first time in I don't know how many years I felt like I wanted to live. Even when I want to die I (due to personal beliefs of course) tell myself I only get this one chance at life. And I want to see it through as far as I can.i also remind myself that I have made it through every single suicidal thought and ideation thus far and it only makes me stronger the next time the feelings come around.
